title: Orbit Board v1.0.0 (Avro Long-Press & Instant Bangla Fix)
changelog: Fixed Avro Long-Press Crash: Added comprehensive null-guards and exception shields across PointerTracker and MainKeyboardView
Instant Direct Bangla: Zero English flash during typing — eliminates raw Latin characters from suggestion callbacks
Ridmik Keyboard Typing Engine: Pure Bengali composition directly sent to InputConnection
Crash-Proof Clipboard & Haptic Feedback: Safe copy/cut/paste and bounded vibration durations
Safe RidmikParser bounds checking to prevent StringIndexOutOfBoundsException
